reviewer: Codex assistant; source-backed inspection, not a blinded human review
limits: Assistant review can make errors; independently authored questions and blinded human review remain deployment gates.

The first unseen generated-content holdout was evaluated on implementation eaf30eb569d418c4195ba595312b638bdcaf19f82e258efa9ace4005f15eae71. Its review is preserved in initial-source-review.json. The final cache authorization and empty-degraded-search fix was independently derived from an authorization probe, not those holdout outcomes; no retrieval ranking or nonempty-evidence prompts changed. The subsequent holdout replay is regression verification, not a second unseen benchmark.
Holdout generator templates were known. Acceptance outcomes informed earlier generic citation-format repairs; acceptance is not a blind final benchmark.
The reserved-book question is ambiguous; the frozen key assumes a pending reservation. Report sensitivity excluding this case.
Supplemental paraphrases reuse known development sources and keys. They were frozen after production code was fixed, before evaluation, and did not inform tuning.

Correct/complete evaluates requested facts and justified uncertainty. Incorrect additional source-scope claims can pass that dimension while failing semantic citation support and unsupported-claim checks. Repeated samples are not independent questions; no confidence interval or perfect-accuracy claim.
metricNotes: Source review is manual and model-assisted; alias screening is not a correctness score.
Citation support is answer-level: every cited substantive claim must be supported by its displayed excerpt. Uncited uncertainty-only responses are excluded from this denominator.
Correctness includes explicit unanswerable cases; incorrect refusals and rejected outputs fail. Grounded correctness additionally requires semantic citation support.
Overall excludes supplemental paraphrases to avoid inflating the primary benchmark with correlated question pairs. Paraphrase and all-evaluated aggregates are separate.
Unsupported secondary source-scope claims are recorded even when the requested answer is a correct refusal. Continuous ranges must not include sections absent from the selected/cited excerpts.
Recall uses original exact normalized source spans plus document identity. Candidate recall is distinct from coverage of selected context. MRR identifies the first supporting selected passage.
All retrieval vectors were prewarmed. Latency excludes cold query embedding, remote database/auth/persistence and browser delivery. Provider generation measurements include conditional repair.
Peak token prices are conservative estimates, not an invoice. Unknown or aborted requests remain reserved in the shared budget ledger.
